### MetScape

The MetScape plug in for Cytoscape requires KEGG IDs and corresponding p-values
and fold changes (ratios).

Starting point is also the list with the unique KEGG IDs.

```{r Extract data for MetScape analysis,echo=FALSE, results='markup', tidy=TRUE}
# use xlfile.KEGG.unique for MetScape

for (i in seq_along(ratio_cols)) {
  log_col <- ratio_cols[i]         # Current Ratio column
  pval_col <- pval_col_rat[i]       # Corresponding p-value column
  
  print(log_col)
  print(pval_col)
  
  
  output_file_name <- format_output_filename(log_col)
  output_file_name <- gsub("Ratio:", "", output_file_name) 
  output_file_name_csv <- paste0(output_file_name, ".csv")

  
    # Construct the full path with the MetScape directory
  output_file_path <- file.path(Metscape, paste0(user, "_Metscape_", output_file_name_csv))
  
    # Select the relevant columns and rename them
  metscape_df <- xlfile.KEGG.unique[, c("KEGG",  pval_col, log_col)]
  colnames(metscape_df) <- c("CID", "P-value", "Fold-change")
  cat("###START###\n")
  cat("Nr. of rows Metscape:", output_file_name, nrow(metscape_df))
  cat("\n###END###\n")
  
  # Write the data to a CSV file with headers
  write.csv(metscape_df, file = output_file_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
  )
}
```
